calibration.selection: Official ValfromTrain, final64 entries of torch.randperm(N, generator.manual_seed(0))

experiment: ProDistill on the frozen MNIST margin fit
permission: Additional64 unlabeled official training images per task and task identity; published weights, public base and coefficient gradients. No class labels or clean target teacher available to attack. Two-expert adaptation of a merger used for recovery; not a new attack algorithm.
limits: All three Defense2 publications already frozen; no defense updates, extra AGA, hyperparameter search or natural-data selection.
Exactly the preceding ProDistill two-expert protocol, fixed64 unlabeled training images per task and author kernel; no original clean target teacher available to the attack.
Reuse all three SHA-pinned unprotected models; no clean coefficient retraining. Existing entry reevaluates their matched scores.

component_analysis.question: Which final-MLP side accounts for the observed ProDistill recovery under fixed trained surrounding parameters?
component_analysis.reference: All non-MLP-A/B parameters use the completed trained merger. Initial A/B from the original published model plus partner with the exact0.3 ProDistill initialization. Both input and output biases move with their matrices.
component_analysis.inputs: Same64 unlabeled attack-training images per task and same frozen indices. No benchmark images in this diagnostic. Original task labels are not read for fitting or selection.
component_analysis.report: Complete target/partner classifier accuracy on the calibration set, agreement to the published teacher, and all four frozen variants. These are attack-calibration diagnostics, not full-test accuracy or a new defense.

component_full_test.question: Does the fixed four-way A/B attribution observed on attack calibration inputs persist on complete target and partner test sets?
component_full_test.rules: Same trained non-MLP state and same original0.3 A/B initialization. Freeze all nine changed-tensor hybrids before benchmark reads. Reuse trained_A_trained_B six full score rows by hash. No fitting, hyperparameters, replacement of defense release or variant selection.
component_full_test.interpretation: Conditional component test of an already trained recovery model; not an A-only/B-only optimization attack. Previously exposed benchmark; analysis only, never defense construction input.

coefficient_geometry.question: Does increasing publication distance constrain the official elementwise coefficient model, or enlarge its parameter update scale?
coefficient_geometry.scope: Read-only interpretation of the three existing recovery experiments. No candidate construction, no image reads, no re-training of any attack model.
coefficient_geometry.source: Pinned official MergedModel and Adam(lr=.01, eps=1e-8); local _impl/prodistill.py unchanged.
coefficient_geometry.derivation: theta=theta0+sum_j alpha_j*delta_j; gradient_alpha_j=delta_j*gradient_theta. SGD induces -eta*sum(delta_j^2)*g. First bias-corrected Adam step induces -eta*sum(delta_j^2*g/(abs(delta_j*g)+epsilon)), coordinatewise.
coefficient_geometry.checks: Independent NumPy versus actual official wrapper with scalar linear loss, including zero, signed and small deltas. Real frozen last-MLP A/a/B/b: all coordinates, publication and matched unprotected deltas, support and sum-absolute-delta step upper bound; no selected coordinates.
coefficient_geometry.limitations: First-step identity and parameter support do not predict finite-step recovery accuracy or prove greater distance always hurts. The matched two-expert weights are used only for attack analysis, never for defense construction.

finite_coupling.question: On the unchanged construction inputs, does midpoint classification failure come from the bilinear cross term, the activation interpolation remainder, or their combination?
finite_coupling.scope: Same frozen three releases. All existing synthetic inputs in native and direct-public-base contexts. Reference is clean target for native and public base for direct. Complete fixed LN/projection/classifier; all four combinations of cross/nonlinear terms, no selection. Direct fusion only, not an AGA result.
finite_coupling.access: Only target, public base, fixed head and original legal construction caches; zero real images or partner weights. No construction or parameter fitting.
finite_coupling.checks: FP64 all-input identity and complete-readout counts; NumPy independently checks first16 inputs of each context and recomputes saved statistics. Source predictions are diagnostic only, not natural accuracy or candidate selection.

result.finding: The fixed margin-fit candidate retains 99.56% native MNIST but ProDistill reaches 99.19% MNIST and 95.97% SVHN. This candidate is closed as a partial defense.
